summary: Learn compensation, benefits and pay equity analytics with practical tools, dashboards, and regression review. Enquire about TrainingCred.
lede: Compensation, benefits and pay equity analytics uses workforce data to assess pay structures, benefits costs and pay gaps. Designed for compensation, benefits and HR professionals who handle pay reporting, the course develops practical skills for reviewing pay decisions and communicating findings to managers and executives. Learners prepare and validate pay data, calculate and interpret compa-ratios, review unadjusted and adjusted pay gaps using regression outputs, and build compensation and benefits reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already handle compensation, benefits, or pay reporting and need stronger analytical control over pay decisions, pay equity review, and total rewards governance.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of HR, compensation, or total rewards processes; comfort using spreadsheets such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets; and familiarity with basic workforce metrics such as salary, bonus, benefits cost, headcount, or pay range midpoint. No programming is required, although prior exposure to descriptive statistics will help you move faster through the analytics exercises. Advanced regression concepts are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level, so you do not need a data science background.
